memberdef.name: ID_SCC_TLM_TARGET_BFS_REGISTER_BASE
memberdef.initializer: "scc: tlm target bitfield support register base"

detaileddescription.para: @Author: Philip Dachs @Date: 2019-06-19T12:30:13+02:00 @Filename: tlm_target_bfs_register_base.h @Last modified by: Johannes Geier (contact: johannes.geier@tum.de) @Last modified time: 2021-01-20T18:11:00+02:00

memberdef.name: BITFIELD_ARRAY_ELEMENT
memberdef.initializer: BOOST_PP_COMMA_IF(i) { \ getRegister(BOOST_PP_TUPLE_ELEM(0, elem)), \ BOOST_PP_TUPLE_ELEM(1, elem) \ BOOST_PP_STRINGIZE(i), BOOST_PP_TUPLE_ELEM(2, elem) + i *BOOST_PP_TUPLE_ELEM(3, elem), BOOST_PP_TUPLE_ELEM(3, elem), \ BOOST_PP_TUPLE_ELEM(4, elem) BOOST_PP_STRINGIZE(i) BOOST_PP_TUPLE_ELEM(5, elem) \ }

briefdescription.para: Implementation detail. Not for general use.

detaileddescription.para:
i
Current index
elem
Tuple of (regname, basename, offset, size, uridbase)
generates the following code {getRegister(<regname>),<basename>"<i>",<offset>+<size>*<i>,<size>, <uridbase>"<i>"<uridpostfix>}

memberdef.name: BITFIELD_ARRAY
memberdef.initializer: BOOST_PP_REPEAT(count, BITFIELD_ARRAY_ELEMENT, (regname, basename, offset, size, uridbase, ))

briefdescription.para: Generates multiple bitfield definitions packed in one register.

detaileddescription.para: repeats the following pattern count times: {getRegister(<regname>),<basename>"<i>",<offset>+<size>*<i>,<size>, <uridbase>"<i>"}

parameterdescription.para: Name of the register the bitfields are part of
Prefix of the bitfield name. Resulting name is <basename><i>
Offset in bits of the first generated bitfield
Size in bits of each bitfield
Prefix of the urids. Resulting urid is <uridbase><i>
The number of bitfields to generate

memberdef.name: BITFIELD_ARRAY_POSTFIX
memberdef.initializer: BOOST_PP_REPEAT(count, BITFIELD_ARRAY_ELEMENT, (regname, basename, offset, size, uridbase, uridpostfix))

briefdescription.para: See BITFIELD_ARRAY. Adds possibility to append postfix to urid pattern.

parameterdescription.para: Postfix of the urids. Resulting urid is <uridbase><i><uridpostfix>

memberdef.name: REGISTER_ARRAY_ELEMENT
memberdef.initializer: BOOST_PP_COMMA_IF(i) { \ BOOST_PP_TUPLE_ELEM(0, elem) \ BOOST_PP_STRINGIZE(i), BOOST_PP_TUPLE_ELEM(1, elem) + i* BOOST_PP_TUPLE_ELEM(2, elem) \ }

briefdescription.para: Implementation detail. Not for general use.

detaileddescription.para:
i
Current index
elem
Tuple of (basename, offset, size)
generates the following code: {<basename>"<i>",<offset>+<i>*<size>}

briefdescription.para: Generates multiple register definitions. repeats the following pattern count times:

parameterdescription.para: Prefix of the register name. Resulting name is <basename><i>
Offset in bytes of the first register. Only decimal numbers are supported
Size in bytes of each register
The number of registers to generate
